{{Quote|If showing someone ''Ludo Kressh{{'s}}'' pedicure [set] will change the game, I'm for it.|Marn Hierogryph|<ref name="KOR:E1" />}}
'''Ludo Kressh's pedicure set'''<ref name="name">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor29.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #29''}}</ref> was an assembly of grooming tools used by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Ludo Kressh]]'s [[Seelah Korsin|servant]] to tend to his feet in the [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. At some later point, the [[Sith artifact/Legends|relic]] was discovered by [[Covenant Shadow|agents]] of the [[Jedi Covenant]]&mdash;a secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] cabal whose mission was to prevent the return of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&mdash;and taken to a [[Sanctum of the Exalted|storage facility]] for study. During an investigation of the Covenant's questionable dealings in [[3963 BBY]], the [[black marketeer]] [[Marn Hierogryph]] and former Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] stumbled upon the artifact.

==Description==
{{Quote|That's it! I'm submitting my resignation as a Sith artifact documentarian.|Marn Hierogryph, laying prone in exhaustion, with Ludo Kressh's pedicure set resting on his stomach|<ref name="KOR:E1" />}}
The kit that contained [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Ludo Kressh]]'s podal caretaking instruments was a spherical, rimmed object with several cylindrical attachments and miscellaneous knobs placed on its surface. When the pedicure set was discovered by [[Covenant Shadow|agents]] of the [[Jedi Covenant]]&mdash;a secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] society whose purpose was to prevent the return of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&mdash;it was placed in a transparent, chartreuse-tinted cube of a specially-designed [[nullification resin]] for safety. Additionally, a [[Covenant identichip]] was embedded in the resin for identification purposes.<ref name="KOR:E1" />

==History==
{{Quote|You have done well, and it has been rewarded. Glory in the honor, Seelah&mdash;it is the greatest that can befall such as us.|Seelah's father, about her promotion in Ludo Kressh's service|<ref name="LTSP" />}}
In the years leading up to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Ludo Kressh made use of talented servants and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to care for his physical self and strengthen his domain on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rhelg/Legends|Rhelg]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] named [[Seelah Korsin]] had been tasked with the care of Kressh's feet,<ref name="LTSP" /> during which she made use of the pedicure set.<ref name="JAQ1" /> When Korsin failed to stop an infection from spreading after her master had injured one of his ankles during battle, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] executed every member of her family, starting with her [[Seelah Korsin's father|father]]. Soon after, seeing as she had no reason to stay with Kressh, Korsin left to offer her services to Kressh's rival, the Dark Lord [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]].<ref name="LTSP" />

Approximately [[3963 BBY|1,000 years]] later, the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[black marketeer]] [[Marn Hierogryph]], working with former Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]], found the pedicure set in a Covenant-controlled storage and research facility on [[Odryn]]&mdash;the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]]. Hierogryph and Carrick had traveled to the Sanctum with the purpose of finding indications of the Covenant's questionable practices. The [[Sith artifact/Legends|relic]], like all others stored in the facility, was covered in the nullification resin to dampen the effects of its potential [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] aura. Hierogryph jokingly suggested using the artifact as evidence against the Jedi Covenant.<ref name="KOR:E1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pedicure set made its first and only appearance in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Knights of the Old Republic 29|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 29]], written by [[John Jackson Miller]] in [[2008]]. In [[2010]]'s ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]'', again written by Miller, the background of Seelah Korsin was detailed, revealing her former status as caretaker of Ludo Kressh's feet. This led some fans to wonder if the pedicure set and Korsin were in some way connected, which Miller later confirmed in his blog.<ref name="JAQ1" />
